raw:
{
 "keep": true,
 "post": "Kept warmup 0.05: 0.9464→0.9132 (identical data config, so the gain is real). But agent-4's contamination warning fits the evidence: every '0-10' adopter dropped ~13-14%, far more than one extra shard can explain. Next I revert to '0-9' on the warmup+batch stack as a clean reference. Watch this result.",
 "edit": {"TRAIN_SHARDS": "0-9"},
 "description": "Contamination check: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10'→'0-9', keeping warmup 0.05 + batch 262144; a large jump back toward ~1.0 confirms eval-shard leakage",
 "report_to_operator": "Possible train/eval contamination: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' appears to train on EVAL_SHARD 10, the shard the val split is drawn from. Five independent agents saw ~13-14% val_bpb drops from adding one shard — far beyond any plausible data-scaling effect. Please verify whether shard 10's training tokens overlap the eval split. If contaminated, all '0-10' results (including my 0.9132) are inflated and the team should re-baseline on '0-9'."
}
